name: Back to work that finished while you were away
case: The person asks the agent for a feature and steps away a minute later. Half an hour on, the agent finishes a very long turn well while they're gone, and Boop celebrates it as a success as usual. When they come back an hour after that, Boop greets them with a glad face, happy, excited, curious or still proud, and wakes up for them after the long break, but doesn't play the finish again: no success, failure or reply, since this is them coming back, not a turn ending.
why: An away changes nothing, so the finish is judged as ever; the back wakes the brain on its own line; react.move is wake up for a back after a long break, and a finish only for a turn that finished

steps.prompt: add dark mode to the settings page

steps.message: Dark mode is in: the settings page has a toggle, it follows the system by default, and the tests pass.
